date.as_written: śrī sāke 1783 saṃvat 1983 mi phāguṇa vadi 8 roja 6

notes: The date Śāke 1783 Phālguna vadi 8 roja 6 (Friday) corresponds to 21 February 1862 CE (= VS 1918, as corrected by the cataloguer; 'saṃvat 1983' is a scribal slip for 1918). In Nepali: '... puttaka ho' means 'is the book of...'; 'satyanārāyaṇako putta ho' refers to the text of Satyanārāyaṇa, not a second person. 'upādhyāyodmālako' reflects sandhi for Upādhyāya + Udmāla/Dumāla (a Nepali Brahmin clan/thar).
